42.name: License Your Software to Arcooda
42.content:
Arcooda is a collaboration of many talented people from around the world. We’re always looking to bring exciting games and features to our community, while working with individuals and companies to create the best products possible. If you have a product (game or hardware) that you think would be suitable for our machine, please contact us below to see how we can work together.

Some examples of our previous partnerships include:

  • Arcooda Pinball Arcade with FarSight Studios

[photos]

  • Development work with Tencent

[photos]

  • Development and Design work with IGS for fish hunter games
